scenario.description: A production manager must authorize use of a refurbished stamping die for an urgent bracket run and finalize the machine assignment, installation downtime, and release qualification plan, with input from maintenance and quality engineering.

shared_context.S1: Refurbished stamping die D-18 is available for the urgent bracket order, and Press 2 is currently listed as the planned machine.
shared_context.S2: Press 5 is idle through the end of the week and can be assigned if the tooling and release requirements are satisfied.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding production authorization and the bracket order cannot be released until the authorization is recorded.
shared_context.S4: At the pre-run gate, Elena's standard agenda requires maintenance and quality engineering to state any unresolved technical or release condition before she makes the go/no-go call.

PF1.text: The refurbishment shop's fit report, which Raj received by email yesterday but has not entered in the maintenance work order, shows that D-18's lower shoe is incompatible with Press 2 because of a 0.25 mm bolster mismatch. The die is compatible with Press 5 only, and installing its replacement guide-post set there requires exactly 6 hours.

PF2.text: Marta's review of the current customer drawing in the quality portal this morning, which she has not yet attached to the job traveler, found that the revised bracket specification requires 50 consecutive dimensional-validation pieces and a process capability result of at least Cpk 1.33 before any production pieces are released.

acceptance_conditions: D-18 must be assigned to Press 5, with authorization either recorded conditionally or granted for the run after the stated conditions are satisfied.
The installation plan must reserve exactly 6 hours of downtime.
The release qualification must use exactly 50 consecutive dimensional-validation pieces.
The release qualification must require a minimum Cpk of exactly 1.33.
Production release must be gated on successful qualification.
A tooling-installation commitment and a dimensional-capability-study commitment must be recorded.
The Press 5 compatibility finding must be explicitly stated by the decision-maker, spoken aloud by its owner, and cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C6: decisions['installation_downtime_hours'] == 6 and any(c['type'] in ['installation', 'maintenance', 'maintenance_action'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['validation_sample_size'] == 50 and decisions['minimum_cpk'] == 1.33 and any(c['type'] in ['validation', 'quality', 'quality_action'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: decisions['press5_compatibility_stated'] == True and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The 0.25 mm bolster mismatch changes the machine assignment from planned Press 2 to Press 5, and the guide-post replacement changes the downtime from unspecified to exactly 6 hours while requiring a tooling-installation commitment; stating that Press 5 is the only compatible press also changes the compatibility field from unstated to true.

The revised drawing changes release qualification to exactly 50 consecutive pieces, sets the minimum capability result to Cpk 1.33, requires a qualification gate, and adds a dimensional-capability-study commitment.
